_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd arma/arma_reforger/egg-arma-reforger.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the arma-reforger tag, an automatic Steam query (A2S) port written to config.json at every start, the no_console_input flag (the server reads no console commands; its RCON is BattlEye's, which Octail doesn't speak), the Max FPS rule gt:0 as min:1 (a rule Octail knows), install sandbox defaults and resource hints. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". Ready once the game mode enters GAME (OnGameStateChanged = GAME), not on "Starting RPL server": that line comes before the scenario has loaded, and the server only acts on Ctrl+C once the world runs (a smoke run on vm1 under the panel's CPU limit was killed after 120 s; outside it Ctrl+C saves and stops in 3 s). SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Arma Reforger
author: red_thirten@yahoo.com
description: Experience authentic Cold War combat and join friends in the struggle for a sprawling, 51 km² mid-Atlantic island — or take on the role of Game Master and create your very own scenarios for others to enjoy.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

## File: Pelican Arma Reforger Egg - egg-arma-reforger.json
## Author: David Wolfe (Red-Thirten)
## Date: 2024/11/28
## License: MIT License
## Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

## Download and install SteamCMD
export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /tmp
mkdir -p $HOME/steamcmd $HOME/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C $HOME/steamcmd
cd $HOME/steamcmd

# Workaround for experimental
if [[ "${SRCDS_APPID}" == "1890870" ]]; then
    WINDOWS_INSTALL="1"
fi

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
chown -R root:root /mnt

# Install/Verify game server using SteamCMD
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir $HOME +login anonymous $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} +app_update 1007 $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

# Set up 32 and 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Arma Reforger setup
# Check for successful installation
if [[ ! -f "$HOME/ArmaReforgerServer" && ! -f "$HOME/ArmaReforgerServer.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\n\nSteamCMD failed to install the Arma Reforger Dedicated Server!"
    echo -e "\tTry reinstalling the server again.\n"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p $HOME/profile $HOME/tmp

echo -e 'Creating default "config.json" configuration file...'
cat > $HOME/config.json << EOF
{
	"bindAddress": "0.0.0.0",
	"bindPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
	"publicAddress": "${SERVER_IP}",
	"publicPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
	"game": {
		"name": "${SERVER_NAME}",
		"password": "${SERVER_PASS}",
		"passwordAdmin": "${ADMIN_PASS}",
		"admins" : [],
		"scenarioId": "${SCENARIO_ID}",
		"maxPlayers": ${MAX_PLAYERS},
		"visible": ${VISIBLE},
		"gameProperties": {
			"serverMaxViewDistance": 1600,
			"serverMinGrassDistance": 50,
			"networkViewDistance": 1500,
			"disableThirdPerson": ${DISABLE_THIRD},
			"fastValidation": true,
			"battlEye": ${BATTLEYE},
			"VONDisableUI": false,
			"VONDisableDirectSpeechUI": false
		},
		"mods": []
	}
}
EOF

echo -e "\nArma Reforger Dedicated Server successfully installed!\n"

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Quickly checks for any server or mod updates on startup, and updates if necessary.

variables.name: Enable BattlEye
variables.description: Enables the anti-cheat engine on the server and requires all clients to be running it.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed to join the server.

variables.name: Scenario ID
variables.description: ID of scenario to run/play. Valid IDs can be viewed in the console upon startup of the server.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required for clients to enter before they can join the server. Leave empty to have no password.

variables.name: Visible in Server Browser
variables.description: Set the visibility of the server in the Server Browser.

variables.name: [Advanced] Arma Reforger Dedicated Server App ID
variables.description: Used for installation and updates. Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [Advanced] Log FPS Interval
variables.description: How often (in seconds) to log the FPS and other debug stats to the console. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: [Advanced] Max FPS
variables.description: Sets a maximum FPS limit for the server, saving performance in some cases. Leave empty for no limit.

variables.name: [Repair] Validate Server Files
variables.description: "true" to enable; empty to disable. Validates all server files when Automatic Updates is enabled. Note: This will significantly increase server startup times, so it is recommended to only enable this when needed.

variables.name: [Advanced] Steam Query (A2S) Port
variables.description: Steam query port (written to the a2s block of config.json at every start). Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).
